title: Austin's Govalle, Civic Center, & Northeast Plans
summary:
*   **Govalle Residential Retrofit Update:** Officials received a status report on the Govalle residential retrofit program, likely a city-led housing improvement initiative.
*   **Civic Center and Northeast Planning:** Discussions were held concerning the city's Civic Center and an inventory related to the Northeast area, hinting at future development or resource management.
*   **Future Agenda Preparation:** The meeting included a work session to discuss items slated for the upcoming March 27 and April 3 agendas.

Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of Council on March 25, 1986.
After a work session was held on strategic planning, the Mayor announced Council would go
into executive session pursuant to Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated
to discuss matters of land acquisition, litigation and for personnel matters.
No official action of the City Council will be taken on any of these matters unless such
item is specifically listed on the agenda. Executive session was from 5:45 p.m. to 6:55
p.m. At that time, the meeting was adjourned. ----
-
Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of the Council on March 26, 1986,
noting the absence of Councilmember Rose. A City Manager report on Status on Govalle
Residential Retrofit Program was given.
Work session was held with discussion on Civic Center, Northeast Inventory and discussion
of agenda items on the March 27 and April 3, 1986 agendas. Council adjourned at 6:33 p.m.
